decisions.item: Scope test for bulk-handling makers (fixed before writing)
decisions.detail: In when the company's own page (or a quoted trade article) names mining, aggregate, cement, minerals or power as a market; mixed grain-plus-minerals is in with a boundary note; grain-, food-, packaging- or pharma-only is skipped. Generic bulk makers whose pages name no market (Continental Screw St. Joseph, Screw Conveyor Corp Visalia) are kept as base with a boundary note because screw conveyors, drag conveyors and bucket elevators for bulk are the vertical's named products and no skip category applies. Young Industries (process powders) skipped; Metalfab (power generation named) kept; Rapat (frac sand plus agricultural) kept; Hi-Roller (grain) skipped.
